title: rosa gallica subsp. leiostyla
intro: Rosa gallica subsp. leiostyla, commonly known as the Red Rose of Provence, is a subspecies of the Gallic rose (Rosa gallica) that is native to the Mediterranean region. This plant has been traditionally used to promote relaxation and reduce stress, due to its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Rosa gallica subsp. leiostyla include reducing anxiety and improving sleep quality, likely due to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils. The bioactive constituents of this plant are believed to be responsible for its therapeutic effects, although further research is needed to confirm its uses and potential benefits.
